A new journey of faith • Jennifer Pulido

A new battle.
The same
faithful God.

The Lord was faithful to Jhen before.
We trust He will be faithful again.

Four years after God healed her from Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma, Jhen is now facing Acute Myeloid Leukemia. Let’s walk beside her and her family through this new battle.

Understanding the new battle

Acute Myeloid Leukemia, or AML, is an aggressive blood cancer that requires urgent and intensive medical care.

Before you visit

Donor qualifications

Be feeling well and in general good health.

  • 18–70 years old. Donors aged 60–70 need physician clearance.
  • Bring a valid ID.
  • At least 3 months or 12 weeks since your last blood donation.
  • Weigh at least 50 kg (110 lbs).
  • No menstruation, as listed in the family’s donor instructions.
  • Non-drinker and non-smoker, as listed in the family’s instructions.
  • No recent tattoo or vaccination.

These are the donor instructions shared by the family. The blood bank evaluates vital signs and other requirements and makes the final eligibility decision. Ask the blood bank about any recent tattoo, vaccination, or other eligibility questions.

Meet Jhen

A life of faith.
A heart for others.

A wife, a mother of three, and a faithful servant of Jesus.

Jennifer “Jhen” Pulido serves as a worship leader, marriage coach, and small-group leader. She has prayed with the sick, visited those who felt alone, encouraged couples, and listened to people carrying quiet burdens.

Today, we have the opportunity to surround her with the same love she has shared with so many.

Faith through every season.

Her journey

Faithful then.
Faithful now.

01

Four years ago

God healed her.

When Non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma entered their lives, Jhen and her family walked through treatment, hospital visits, and uncertainty together. By God’s grace, she overcame cancer. Her family gives God the glory for her healing.

02

Life after healing

Everyday moments became gifts.

Family meals, worship, birthdays, laughter, and time together became even more precious. Life moved forward, with gratitude.

03

The new battle

Now, she faces AML.

Jhen has been diagnosed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia. This new diagnosis brings tears, questions, and another season of treatment. But their faith remains: Jesus walked with them before, and they trust Him to walk with them now.

Our hope remains in Jesus

We don’t know what tomorrow holds.
We know Who goes with us.

We continue to trust God for Jhen’s healing and for the funds needed for her chemotherapy. Thank you for carrying this burden with us, praying with us, and believing with us for healing and provision.

“And my God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.”Philippians 4:19 · ESV
